adaptive_policy.m: smallest of {1.0,1.25,...,4.0} covering every development OOF FRF, else adaptive is not calibratable
adaptive_policy.statistic: fraction of cells with sigmoid score >= 0.5

adoption_minimums.native_seam: a Z80 selective-admission contract (admitted-start set, typed unadmitted-PC behavior, validator) that does not exist today
adoption_minimums.note: 6 development lineages < 8: native integration (T004) and launcher Optimized mode for Z80 are NOT_JUSTIFIED regardless of the pilot outcome

candidates.C1: byte embedding(16) -> 4x Conv1d(k=5, dilations 1,2,4,8, 32 ch, ReLU) -> per-cell [mean,max] pooling -> linear(1)
candidates.C2: C1 plus Z80 decode tokens: kind embedding(4), total-length embedding(4), form embedding(8) from z80-decode-token-report

controls: linear byte-histogram logistic regression per cell (no spatial context)

economics.projection: compile CPU is linear in image size (SMS baselines); projected CPU = intercept + slope * retained fraction * KiB. Labelled a PROJECTION: no selective Z80 producer exists to measure

excluded.devkitsms_sdcc_homebrew: prebuilt library binaries without listings and Windows-only tools; not counted (follow-up)
excluded.smslib_examples: one library; listing text unresolved for section-heavy code; not counted
excluded.sonic2_sms: upstream source targets a different revision than the local cartridge (37,886 bytes differ) and its repository bundles a commercial image; also the same engine family as sonic1 -> excluded

fixed_policy: B_fixed = ceil_to_0.05(max over development OOF FRF + 0.05)
independence_evidence: pairwise 12-byte instruction-run shingle overlap across all 9 lineages: maximum 3.3% of the smaller set (alexkidd/supertennis), all others below 2%

order_statement: This plan, its digest and the trainer are committed and pushed before any model is fitted or any held-out result is computed.
policy_selection: C2 replaces C1 only if its development out-of-fold mean FRF is lower than C1 by at least 0.05 absolute; otherwise C1
protocol: development folds: leave-one-lineage-out over the 6 development lineages (train on 5, score the held-out one) -> OOF scores, FRF, calibrations
final: fit the selected candidate on all 6 development lineages; score the 3 sealed lineages exactly once with the frozen budget policies
sealed_rule: sealed = the first 3 lineages ordered by sha256("seg051-sealed-v1:"+id); fixed before any model exists
stage: EXPLORATORY_PILOT (not an adoption candidate; adoption minimums below are NOT met by this corpus)

success_pilot.sealed_strict_recall: every source instruction-start cell of every sealed lineage is inside the policy selection (any miss = RECALL_FAILED)
success_pilot.selectivity: mean retained fraction on sealed lineages <= 0.65

training.loss: binary cross-entropy with pos_weight = negatives/positives of the training cells, labelled cells only, crop edge cells excluded
training.seed_aggregation: cell logits averaged across the three seeds

unit.negative: every byte of the cell is confident data (D)
